notes.title: Developer Log – New Content Showcase & V0.9 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I'm SlackCat, the developer of Windstop Strategy. It's been quite a while since I last updated you on the development progress. During this absence, we've been continuously monitoring various suggestions and feedback from our community players, and have set new directions for the game's future development.



After two small-scale internal tests and several months of polishing, the V0.9 major content update for Windstop Strategy Demo is finally ready to meet everyone! So this time, let me explain what new content and gameplay this update will bring!


1. Combat Changes


First point: Windstop Strategy's combat WILL NOT be changed to a card-based system!!! We have completely abandoned card-based modifications!! Additionally, we've added some new mechanics to the combat foundation - details can be found in the update log at the end.

The current combat system mainly simplifies the previous version by removing the mana mechanics (Inner Power and Qi Gathering), strengthening skill mechanics, and splitting each turn into a Strategy Phase and Combat Phase.


Strategy Phase
In the Strategy Phase, you can see the enemy's skill sequence and decide your own skill order based on the current battlefield situation.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/e37a750cd82d5d0100fc518bf9641dc00d163a57.png"]

After setting your skill sequence, click the 【Fight】 button on the right to enter the Combat Phase.


Combat Phase
Similar to the old combat system, characters will execute skills in the predetermined order, except that skill execution now alternates between allies and enemies. After all skills are executed, all characters will perform a basic attack based on their speed stat.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/1d85fa0a62f1a25cf5e176ff52a0d52e755f9972.png"]
Auto Combat
In auto combat mode, the AI will decide skill usage for you, behaving essentially the same as the old version's combat.

We've also simplified the skill targeting system (previously similar to Unicorn Overlord's programming approach). Most attack skills now prioritize targets in the same row, while healing skills favor characters with lower HP. This places more emphasis on character positioning and skill usage decisions during combat.


2. Character Progression Adjustments

Enhanced Character Differentiation


In previous versions, many special NPC characters felt too similar to generic characters, especially after being fully developed. Beyond unique artwork/models and storylines, even when unlocking exclusive equipment, players might prefer giving it to stronger generic characters.



Therefore, we've essentially reworked all recruitable characters' initial traits, strengthening their unique functionalities. These traits can be further upgraded as character stories progress.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/ede744de947e91a39ca8c20133322b35044c3266.png"]



We've also designed some exclusive legendary treasures for different characters.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/7d4def1e8d6928df162b64f6341d7e164a73d20d.png"]




3. BOSS Battles


As more factions unlock in later game stages, simple attack/defense battles might feel monotonous. Therefore, we're introducing unique BOSS battles at certain faction story points or dungeons, emphasizing formation and combat strategy.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/2c10248db321146acd7ca2f7a4f8918a45ed821c.png"]

The V0.9 test version includes one challenging BOSS battle for players to experience.


4. World Map Strategy


For special map strategy gameplay, our current design leans more toward Sengoku Rance's approach - triggering events by spending action points to provide multiple approaches for conquering factions.

Reasons: 1) Strong main story events conflict with pure sandbox strategy gameplay (like Paradox-style grand strategy or Total War's economic/diplomatic systems); 2) Our team's current size and resources can't support developing a complete grand strategy game.

Thus, our focus remains on polishing core gameplay. However, we plan to add a story-free sandbox mode in the future to implement deeper farming/diplomacy mechanics separately from story events.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/6c23f54acb40b6ea7f0034293f741c2a738f8d4c.png"]
5. Visual Improvements
We've upgraded the game's overall visual presentation, now implemented in the V0.9 Demo.


UI Overhaul
We've redesigned most UIs to unify the art style and optimize information display.

 
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/1f68a3acc5a57a6cb01b0c16b134e53eb0fcaab5.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/ec30b26cc90b82e10cba10b4c692f778018c408f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/b8813a20a3ac37bb208c8db02aebe1dcc2b42607.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/f90bbe3fab76210ce29deb762deebfa4e6a4f737.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/b7d8cca454cd353dc0c1f307af87f15def8b4519.png"] [/carousel]
 
Character Art


We've replaced all generic faction NPC AI-generated art with hand-drawn illustrations.


Combat Visuals


We've adjusted hit/knockback animations and designed special effects/performances for BOSS battles. More enhancements (animations, effects, etc.) will come in the full release.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/3c5969bfdb8735a732b0f6e17ca55b7eea5099cd.png"]


6. Story Content


Now about the story - we've categorized it into several types:


Main Story


The main story follows a multi-ending, multi-playthrough structure divided into phases. At each phase, you may need to complete key events or make crucial decisions.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/c2f362211cdf8acdf488a9f3ad05f35b2cabc2ce.png"]

Some choices may affect final battle difficulty, while others directly influence endings.


Faction Stories


Faction stories provide plot clues and may have different routes (like existing Demo content - Dragon Bay's Boar Branch that observant players may have noticed).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/69a1ac1b4b987f3700e9a0c7645ec0cac989f4e8.png"]

Later factions will have fewer branching paths to streamline the narrative.


Dungeons


The Daughter Village dungeon proved successful in testing, offering good expansion opportunities:

Additional character backstory and recruitment motivation

Hidden plot clues rewarding legendary items

Alternative faction conquest strategies (like defeating a faction boss early)

Repeatable dungeons for farming resources



Subsequent faction dungeons follow this design as narrative supplements and high-end reward sources.


Character Stories


Character stories remain as character development and personality supplements.




7. MOD Support


About MODs: Due to significant V0.9 changes, old saves and MODs won't work. We'll provide MOD migration tools before official release to help MOD authors update their work.



That covers this dev log's content. The full update log is below for reference.


:zs_coffee::zs_coffee: V0.9 Update Content :zs_coffee::zs_coffee:


 Major Updates

Combat system overhaul including talents, skills, traits, buffs, Tiger Flame points, equipment, and BOSS battles

Numerical adjustments and corresponding story rewards, character creation mechanics

Dialogue and cutscene optimizations, plus reorganized early-game story

New trait system: permanent traits can upgrade but have activation limits; starting traits adjusted

High-difficulty item use limits: each character has usage caps per item type

Injury system changed from percentage-based to fixed values, affecting related items/healing

Massive UI redesigns and optimizations

Combat visuals and sound effects improved

New BGM tracks, NPC art, and story CGs added

Numerous bug fixes

Fortune cultivation won't give lower-tier traits if higher ones exist



 Bug Fixes

Additions

That covers all Windstop Strategy V0.9 Demo content!

Thank you for your continued support and patience! We sincerely hope players can try this new version and provide feedback!

notes.title: New beta version is on the way
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This is the first developer log since "Windstop Valley" was announced on Steam. It has been two weeks since we first invited everyone to test the game. In the days to come, until the official release of the game, we will periodically talk about the project's progress and hope to listen to your suggestions to make a better game!

Let's briefly introduce the project:

"Windstop Valley" is a strategy RPG indie game that was created in our spare time by a few friends who met through the GitHub open-source project "Heroes Legend Startup." Our game is positioned as "a story-driven, strategy-based wuxia RPG that is easy to expand with MODs." Those familiar with our work may notice that the basic system and some regional suppression mechanics are similar to Japanese-style RPGs. Indeed, we can candidly say that our inspiration comes from "Sengoku Rance," and our game can be considered a tribute to it. Of course, we are also eager to combine this niche gameplay with wuxia content to see if we can spark some new excitement.

We are delighted that since the beginning of the V0.2 test this month, we have received plenty of player suggestions and positive feedback! (We are pleasantly surprised.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/46805fc2e7a23509915f99f9929e14ed72657fa1.png

Based on the test results, we are preparing for the next test version. We plan to meet you with the V0.3 test version at the end of March, when we will release a Steam demo that everyone can experience!

Here are some improvements we are focusing on based on your feedback:

1. Art Style

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/c8ecd5c684f6f66cfc021119e71b7c8e253f9bdb.png

Although the survey results far exceeded our expectations (because we didn't focus much on the art before, and many elements were AI-generated due to limited manpower with a focus on system implementation), we have started to seriously consider the artistic direction for the final game. For example, we have redrawn the protagonist Situ Laiye (still adjusting details), and added expressions to the game's story presentation, which will all be seen in the next version.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/6fb56d4a7d792de1a61444f458fdec3961a8f1d2.png

Additionally, character models, the world map, and UI are all being revamped.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/9ff1b9eb257acbea2e6b6c3d9d6c52d348497a31.png

2. Story Adjustments

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/c63bf06de590e1bc90b6f6d239dcec46fa01df78.png

In the V0.2 test survey, a significant number of players found the story too frivolous, and the overall atmosphere needed improvement. A considerable number of female players also felt the script was too "rough."
In response, we are refining all story scripts and performances, as well as rethinking the world view.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/a557307304302d66d254cbef5c0febfb8e66ed1c.png

3. Interaction Adjustments

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/2ba4d27c402c8a57c90d535956ede9c2f11fa1d0.png

All existing UI/UX were temporarily cobbled together without a unified design language.
We are now comprehensively sorting this out, and the next time you see it, it won't look as "makeshift"! We will also add necessary textures, animations, and auditory effects to all interaction modules.

4. Combat Strategy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/d7b619448564b6fd72d7e8a4726f2af2d0f10f76.png

We are glad that the relatively "relaxing" combat mode has been well received. Moving forward, while maintaining the core combat mode, we will make some adjustments. We'll optimize some of the more frivolous number settings and overly powerful skills, and we'll add some interesting and challenging objectives.

5. Workshop and MOD Editor
The game will support the Steam Workshop, and we are currently doing the preparatory work for it.
We plan to provide an in-game MOD editor, integrating the game's debugging and development functions to allow every interested friend to express their creativity.
However, this module is not planned to be included in the March test content and will meet with everyone in the next version.

6. Multilingual Support
We are preparing a multi-language translation framework, and the game will be released in a variety of languages.

That's all for today's update. Thank you for your attention, and if you like our work, consider adding it to your Steam "Wishlist"!
We look forward to sharing more about the game with you and engaging in discussions!
